title: Score System for Prediction Risk and Early Diagnosis of HCC in HIV/HCV Patients
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to establish a clinical score panel based on clinical, molecular and genetic parameters that allow us to stratify and obtain an early detection of patients with an increased risk of developing hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Human immunodeficiency virus chronic infection
* Hepatitis C virus chronic infection
* No other liver viral coinfections

Exclusion Criteria:

* Alcohol consume
* Immunosuppressor or immunoactive treatment
study_population: HIV/HCV coinfected patients from Infectious Diseases Department
